description: Generate every common app icon size from one image — 16, 32, 48, 180, 192 and 512 px — with instant preview and one-click PNG downloads.

faqs.a: 16×16 and 32×32 favicons, 48×48, 180×180 (Apple touch icon), 192×192 and 512×512 (PWA / Android).
Use the rounded-corner option if you want, but Apple and Android round icons automatically — square master artwork is the safest starting point.
faqs.q: Should my source image have rounded corners?

faqs.a: Icons are exported as PNG with crisp resampling. Large transparent areas stay transparent.
faqs.q: Are the icons exported as PNG?

faqs.a: No — everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Upload your master icon artwork (square works best).
Preview all six standard sizes instantly.
Download each size individually, or all sizes at once.
title: App Icon Resizer
